subject: Game submission: SENGOKU VS — build a castle town and plan a Sengoku campaign in your browser
verification: Gmail SENT readback confirmed recipient and subject. No editorial acceptance or publication confirmed.
body:
Hello Indie Games Plus editorial team,

I’m writing from KASAI SOLUTIONS to share SENGOKU VS (戦国VS), a browser strategy game about building a realm from one castle. Its loop connects town resources, officer assignments and campaign decisions, with in-game advice to help players prepare their next move. We have just added an English introduction and a 36-second game-screen introduction.

The game interface itself is currently Japanese-only. The English page explains the controls needed to start; it is not an English localization of the game.

Players choose a home castle, develop its town, recruit and organize officers, and plan campaigns against computer-controlled factions. Registering a lord unlocks online battles, alliances, letters, trading and cross-device synchronization.

Key facts:
• 256 officers, 129 castles and locations, and 64 facility types.
• Desktop, phone and tablet browsers; no app installation.
• Basic play is free. Optional cosmetics and monthly support provide no combat or resource advantages.
• A local personal campaign can be started without registering a lord.

Thank you for considering the game for coverage.
